metadata.name: R7 Query Severity Diagnostic v1
metadata.author: Codex AI
metadata.source_access_boundary: The author read only canonical-only.json. No base corpus, course material, answers, relevance labels, retrieval output, or API responses were accessed.

severity_definition.L0: Unchanged canonical wording; formal terminology retained.
severity_definition.L1: Added natural spoken phrasing while retaining the named algorithm or data structure and the original constraints.
severity_definition.L2: Replaced part of the technical phrasing with everyday language while preserving a named or explicit core concept.
severity_definition.L3: Removed the algorithm/data-structure name and used a mechanism-level everyday description; preserved the distinguishing constraints needed to recover the information need.
severity_definition.L4: Removed at least one distinguishing mechanism or constraint; more than one interpretation is plausible, so the inherited single-intent answer must not be treated as unique gold.

metadata.level_ordering_note: Levels are authored qualitative strata, not a validated continuous measure of colloquialness. L4 changes answerability by deliberately under-specifying intent.
metadata.gold_policy: L0-L3 retain their intended canonical information need provisionally after an AI-only wording review. L4 is a separate ambiguity/clarification diagnostic and must not use a unique inherited retrieval answer as gold.
metadata.interpretation_note: possible_interpretations are author-written plausible meanings, not exhaustive gold labels or facts retrieved from source materials.
metadata.review: All 120 strings were reviewed during authoring for naturalness, level distinction, retention/removal of discriminating constraints, and absence of an explicit request to clarify. Independent review is still advisable; these are not human-authored or human-validated queries.

pre_freeze_amendments.reason: Query-only audit found rotation plus height balance insufficient to distinguish AVL; add one-level bound, without the asked formula.
